newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 1.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 1.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Tuesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Clear skies and warm weather with maximum winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to six feet high.
The ministry continued to warn against shipping near the islands 363 miles west of the coastline because of residual winds from Tropical Depression Carlos.

Cloudy in the Campeche Sound with light and moderate rains along the coasts of Tamaulipas, Veracruz, Tabasco, Campeche and Yucatan states. Winds from 10 to 15 knots and waves from three to five feet high.
Rains along the coasts of Quintana Roo and Belize, with winds at 10 to 15 knots and waves four to six feet high.
